ld.description: CHRISTMAS EDITION DRAG BRUNCH 🎄✨Duct Tape und Fritz-Kola laden euch zur Christmas Edition unseres Drag Brunch ein!Am Sonntag, den 13. ld.description: HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027 | edition #s6xBERLIN’S QUEEREST MAIN PARTYJuly 24, 2027.  Berlin Pride hits its peak — and House of Pride takes over after the Parade.For one unforgettable night our multi-venue Ritter Butzke, AQUAHŌFE Berlin & Kreuzwerk transform into a massive queer playground in the heart of Berlin: seven areas, indoor & outdoor, packed with beats, 50+ performers & djs, wild energy and thousands of people coming together to celebrate exactly who they are.House of Pride is not just another party. It’s a statement. A celebration. A beautiful, sweaty, loud and unapologetic explosion of queer culture. The event supports Berlin Pride and a beneficial project every year! From house to techno, disco to pop, RnB, rave & to everything in between, expect a genre-hopping journey through some of Berlin’s most iconic spaces — with 50+ artists, spectacular performances and enough energy to carry you through 12+ hours of Pride night.Come for the music. Stay for the madness. Dance with strangers. Kiss whoever you want. Lose yourself in the crowd.No labels. No limits. No judgment. Just Pride.HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027July 24, 2027 | 21:00  7 AREAS · INDOOR & OUTDOOR 50+ ARTISTS · 5 GENRES 3,500+ PEOPLE · 12+ HOURS KREUZBERG · BERLINThe official Main Party of Berlin Pride | CSD Berlin 2027.Headliner & Line-Up: TBAThis is your Pride night. Make it c(o)unt.
ld.name: House of Pride (HOP) Berlin | THE MAIN PARTY OF BERLIN PRIDE

ld.description: Mainfloor: 'diefeder' (Millennial Pop-Mix)Loungefloor: Little A (00er R'n'B HipHop)Salonfloor: tba «Ist das noch Indie?!»  Wir bringen SexyBack! Am Samstag, den 14. Novomber, verwandelt sich unser kleiner Wohlfühlclub in das Epizentrum für pure Nullerjahre-Nostalgie. Mit dem „Millennial Mixtape“ feiern wir den Sound und das Lebensgefühl eines unvergesslich unbeschwerten Jahrzehnts.Drei Floors – Drei Welten Egal, welche Musikrichtung eure Jugend geprägt hat – auf dem „Millennial Mixtape“ finden alle ihre ganz persönlichen absoluten 00er Banger:• Mainflloor: Die Pop-Explosion mit 'diefeder'! – Hier regieren die Königinnen und Könige der Nullerjahre. Tanzt zu Britney Spears, den No Angels, Justin Timberlake, Shakira und der besten Kylie ever.• Radaufloor: "Little A" und sein Hip-Hop & R&B Mix – Hey Ya, willkommen In da Club! Fette Bässe und smoother Groove. Freut euch auf die Tracks von Eminem, 50 Cent, Beyoncé, Nelly und Usher.• Salon: Indie & Rock-Alternative selektiert von DJ Snacky Baba & DJ tba – «Ist das noch Indie?!» Wir sagen: Das ist Disco! Von Arctic Monkeys bis Whitney Houston, von Kraftklub bis Charli XCX und von Two Door Cinema Club bis Nina Chuba wird für alle etwas dabei sein! Die Hardfacts:• Event: Millennial Mixtape – Das Revival der Nullerjahre auf 3 Floors!• Wann: Samstag, 14. Novmeber 2026, ab 21:00 Uhr• Wo: Frannz Club (in der Kulturbrauerei), Schönhauser Allee 36, 10435 Berlin• Eintritt: Early Bird für 8,00 Euro (nur von 21:00 bis 22:00 Uhr und nur an der Abendkasse), danach regulär 12,00 Euro an der Abendkasse. Sichert euch euren Platz auf der Tanzfläche und spult mit uns das Mixtape eurer Jugend zurück!
ld.name: Millennial Mixtape- Das Revival der Nullerjahre auf 3 Floors!

ld.description: SHOW 100% in SPANISH!Relachen dice hasta luego, Berlín! 2014 - 2026Patricia Fernández, fundadora y presentadora del show desde 2014, cambia de residencia (de Berlín a Valencia, España), y por esto cerraremos A LO GRANDE con profundo agradecimiento y alegría esta era de comedia en español en Berlín!Este 13 de noviembre contaremos con 8 (se lee OCHO 🤩) fantásticas presentaciones seleccionadas de entre tod@s l@s maravillos@s artistas que, a lo largo de estos 12 años, han formado (y siempre formarán 💘) parte de este hermoso universo cómico:  ✨ Liliana Velásquez (COL) https://www.instagram.com/ladios_v/  ✨ Ayla Merino (MEX) https://www.instagram.com/aylamerino/  ✨ Eliecer Reyes (ESP) https://www.instagram.com/eliecerreyesfalcon/  ✨ Palma Palacios (RD) https://www.instagram.com/palmapalacios/  ✨ ELGRANDE BBX (PER) https://www.instagram.com/elgrandebbx/  ✨ Doel Cupo(MEX) https://www.instagram.com/doelcupo/  ✨ Lu Noboa (ECU) https://www.instagram.com/lalunoboa/  ✨ Chiquilove (VEN) https://www.instagram.com/chiquilovelovelove/Y, al más puro estilo Berlín, Patricia presentará su nuevo número de cabaret: 🎂 cake sitting, nunca antes visto en Relachen! 🤩🔝 Como siempre, ¡calidad garantizada!  Invitamos a toda nuestra querida comunidad hispanoparlante (y adherid@s 😉) a formar parte de esta ÚNICA experiencia. Todo ocurrirá en CIRCUS POTOO, un maravilloso nuevo espacio cultural que tenemos muchas ganas de que conozcan y disfruten.🗣️ Show 100% en español 🔞 Para mayores de 18 años 💶 El bar acepta SÓLO EFECTIVO Si quieres acceder a uno de los solitickets, simplemente escribe al instagram de Relachen (https://www.instagram.com/relachen_berlin/)Nota: Lastimosamente la entrada al recinto (aun) no está adaptada para personas con movilidad reducida.Abriremos puertas a las 18:30h ¡Lleguen temprano porque en el circo hay juegos y entretenimiento análogo que van a querer probar! Show a las 19:30h 🥳💃🏽🕺🏻🤸🏼‍♀️🎶 Luego del show habrá música, baile, canto y, claro que sí, mucho mas RELAJO¡Les esperamos con amor y humor! 💋________________________🎪 INFOS ABOUT THE VENUE 🎪The Circus Potoo is located in a Historic Vaulted Cellar, therefore it is important that all of our guests are respectful to the space. When you purchase a ticket, you agree to follow these simple rules:🚭 NO SMOKING 🚫 NO GRAFFITI   We urge you to be mindful of the flooring and to watch you step as you move through the space. The venue does not have step-free access but this is something we aim to work on for the future.Circus Potoo strives to be a safe space for all walks of life, we do not tolerate discrimination or agressive behaviour towards our staff, artists or guests. Management reserves the right to refuse admission and tickets are non-transferable or refundable unless the event is cancelled.CASH ONLYADULTS ONLY
ld.name: Relachen: cierre de una era

ld.description: Tipsy Bear presents: Sleigh Queens! 🛷👑Just before Christmas, Tipsy turns into a glittering winter wonderland for one very special night of drag. ❄️Sleigh Queens is a holiday-themed Christmas show with a festive Berlin lineup: expect lip syncs, live performances, camp comedy and an ugly christmas sweater contest.
